name: import-zen-from-the-pane
description: The import pane previews the staged Zen fixture and imports it, and Settings closes at once. The sidebar gains the Home workspace. The Zen folder is the hand-built fixture in fixtures/import/zen/basic. Zen has no routing rules, so the card after the run still reads the same counts as the preview.

actions.note: Atrium frontmost, or cmd+comma opens Finder Settings

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="import"]'); if (!item) { return 'no import rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: evidence: the Zen card with its counts, light mode

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.import-card[data-source="zen"] .import-run'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: close Settings at once, while the run may still be in flight
the Home workspace reaches the sidebar with Settings closed

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="import"]'); if (!item) { return 'no rail'; } item.click(); return document.querySelector('.import-card[data-source="zen"] .import-counts') ? 'card' : 'waiting'; })()
actions.note: a wait_vlog would match the first window's lines, so this polls the reopened page

assertions.desc: the card is still shown after the run, and its refreshed preview counts the same Zen files
Cmd+Q still quits cleanly after an import
